hotels.title: Boutique Daylesford Spa Country Retreat 90 Minutes from Melbourne with Daily Breakfast & Dining Credit
hotels.description: Embrace Daylesford's majestic natural scenery with a boutique Parisian-style stay, only a 90-minute drive from Melbourne. A private haven of just 15 unique rooms, Hotel Frangos offers the perfect retreat for those wanting to leave urban life behind and experience the tranquillity of picturesque country Victoria. Spend your time taste-testing the local wine at one of the region's many vineyards, enjoy a picnic at Lake Daylesford, dine your way through the town's array of hatted restaurants or refresh your body, mind and soul in Hepburn Springs' famous mineral waters. This rural retreat is also home to the charming Café Koukla, serving a wide selection of locally sourced favourites, sweet treats, cocktails and wine under the vine-covered verandah. Full of character and distinctive design, Hotel Frangos offers a wonderful opportunity for travellers to lose themselves in one of Victoria’s most cherished leisure regions.
